critical_code_review_comments: aria_agent_routes.py — Clean, well-structured 469-line additive module. Good separation: each section gets its own block + inline static seed data (PLAYBOOKS, DEFAULT_JOURNEY, JOURNEY_TEMPLATES, HANDOFF_RULES, REVIVAL_JOURNEY). Single responsibility per route. Demo-padding fallbacks for handoff/alerts and agent-activity are correctly gated and clearly commented as 'feel alive on demo workspaces'.

aria_agent_routes.py:67 get_training — uses `training_collection.find_one(...)` (sync pymongo) inside an async route. Same pattern is used everywhere in the file (find_one, count_documents, update_one, delete_one are all sync). Server.py likely already runs sync pymongo; if motor is the project's async driver the code should use `await collection.find_one(...)`. Need to confirm — but since regressions pass and these endpoints respond fast, this is a code-style nit, not a runtime bug. Recommend aligning to whatever convention server.py already uses.
aria_agent_routes.py:209 generate_founder_brief — wraps `ObjectId(lead_id)` in try/except and raises 400 'Invalid lead id' on parse failure. Good defensive handling.

aria_agent_routes.py:218 founder-brief — heuristic uses lead.icp_score, source_channel, company_name, metadata.{need,pain,current,objection}. Falls back gracefully. Result feels alive on real and seeded data.
aria_agent_routes.py:280 handoff_alerts — query is bounded (limit=40, break at 6), then padded if <3. No N+1, no unbounded scans. Good.
aria_agent_routes.py:155 activate_playbook — uses upsert pattern + only stores playbook_id/activated_at/activated_by, not the whole playbook payload. Lean, correct.

aria_agent_routes.py:380 agent-activity — uses `created_at >= day_start.isoformat()` for activity counts. Works when created_at is stored as ISO string but would break for native datetime. Verify the activities collection storage format. Also the 'computed_from_real_data' boolean is a nice transparency flag for the FE.
aria_agent_routes.py:467 attach_aria_agent_routes — clean attach function. Good.
TrainAria.js — Section testids use `train-section-*` prefix (consistent with other train-* testids). 8 tone options correctly mapped. Save flow has proper saving state and 3s success banner.

Layout.js — nav-section-aria-agent divider correctly added. 7 new nav items use kebab-case label-derived testids (nav-train-aria, nav-sales-playbooks, etc). Both expanded and collapsed sidebar verified.
